decisions.reason: The black-finish range is a surface variant of core drainage technology that the firm can produce and evaluate with existing know-how, though it is only mentioned on the website and its demand follows design trends.
The shower channel for seamless coverings builds directly on deep drainage expertise and the barrier-free strategy, and its dedicated page signals continued commitment.

The pump-assisted line stretches the firm into pump technology where its knowledge is thinner, and the newer pump-drain channel F may overlap with it, but in-house R&D lets the firm keep learning from it.
The newly launched pump-drain shower channel has its own web page and applies the firm's growing pump-drainage learning to its core shower channel know-how, so it deserves time to show results.
